name: so101_vial_to_rack_mujoco_warp_wall_clock_v0
description: Wall-clock SO-101 vial-to-rack benchmark using a MuJoCo Warp batched training collector and CPU MuJoCo reference eval.
notes: Use with seed_trainable_vectorized.py on a CUDA host with mujoco_warp installed.
Training collection uses the real MuJoCo Menagerie RobotStudio SO-101 MJCF and engineering-guess Feetech joint dynamics plus printed-plastic gripper contact.
Fixed eval remains the CPU MuJoCo vial-to-rack env and eval_cases.json, so approximate MJWarp collector parameters are treated as a train-time sim-to-real gap.
Success still requires the vial center to be in the rack slot and the vial to remain upright at rack height.

Dense reward shaping follows the SO101-Nexus v0.3.12 PickAndPlaceEnv/RewardConfig structure: reach progress, grasp signal, grasp-gated placement progress, and completion bonus. Credit: https://pypi.org/project/so101-nexus-mujoco/
